differences.what: Everything is flat-shaded, untextured low-poly. The stair, bridge parapet, pole and sidewalk read as clean plastic, not as the heavily rusted, graffiti-tagged, grime-streaked steel and concrete in the reference.
differences.where: Whole frame, worst on the left foreground stair, the bridge parapet across the upper center, and the center pole
differences.fix: Apply PBR materials. The parapet panels need riveted steel with orange-brown rust runs, peeling grey paint and black spray-paint tags. The stair treads need wet diamond-plate steel with rusty nosings. The pole needs dark wet painted steel with rust streaks. Use roughness maps so wet areas are glossy and rusted areas are matte.

differences.what: Wrong stair construction. The capture has a solid block staircase with a plain wall on the left and one slanted slab as a parapet. The reference has an open steel stair with tubular rusty handrails and vertical balusters on both sides, and yellow-black caution tape wrapped around the left rail.
differences.fix: Rebuild it as an open-riser steel stair with diamond-plate treads, round handrails, vertical balusters every ~15 cm on both sides and rusty stringers. Wrap yellow/black tape on the left rail near the bottom. Widen the stair so its right railing reaches about x=520 and its base meets the sidewalk at bottom center-left.

differences.what: Color and lighting are cold, flat blue-grey with lifted ambient. The reference is a warm-and-cool night: deep near-black shadows, a violet sky, and warm amber/sodium pools from the storefronts, the lamp under the bridge and windows.
differences.where: Global, especially the bridge underside, sidewalk and stair
differences.fix: Cut ambient and hemispheric fill by about 60% and remove the blue tint from the shadows. Add warm point and area lights at the storefronts, the under-bridge fluorescent and the orange wall lamp beside the vending machine. Grade toward teal-black shadows with amber highlights, and add a violet/magenta sky glow behind the towers.

differences.what: The road looks like a flooded water plane with wavy, choppy reflections, ripple rings and a large pale-blue blob. The reference is wet asphalt with thin, long, vertically stretched streak reflections of the neon and windows, and the dark asphalt texture still shows through.
differences.where: Road surface, center-right and lower-right; the blob is at center-right, y 750–860
differences.fix: Replace the water plane with an asphalt material (low roughness, ~0.05–0.15, in puddles; ~0.4 elsewhere). Use SSR or planar reflections with vertical anisotropic stretch so the red/amber/pink lights smear into long vertical streaks. Remove the wave normal, the ripple rings and the pale-blue blob. Keep the white lane marking and the faded arrow visible under the sheen.

differences.what: The sidewalk is matte, untextured blue-grey slabs. The reference has a dark tiled paver sidewalk with tactile paving strips, a granite curb, and strong glossy specular highlights from the street lights.
differences.fix: Use small dark rectangular pavers with grout lines, a yellow/grey tactile strip near the curb and a raised stone curb edge. Make the wet sheen strong enough to catch warm highlights and blurred reflections of the stair and pole.

differences.what: Rain is overdone and looks wrong. The streaks are long, bright and evenly spread across the frame, and many white dots read as snow or sparkles. In the reference the rain is fine, thin, low-contrast streaks visible mostly against lights.
differences.where: Whole frame, most obvious against the sky and the dark road on the right
differences.fix: Cut rain opacity by about 70% and streak width by half. Remove the round dot particles and splash sprites floating in mid-air. Brighten streaks only where they cross light sources such as the storefronts and the neon. Add a fine mist/haze layer instead.

differences.what: The background skyscrapers are flat dark-purple slabs with random tiny rectangles in cyan, pink and white. The reference towers show readable facades: floor bands, mullions, a regular grid of mostly warm amber lit windows, and a distant red-lit antenna spire in atmospheric haze.
differences.fix: Give the towers modeled or textured facade grids with regular window rows. Light about 30% of windows in warm amber (2700–3500 K) and leave the rest dark. Drop the random cyan and pink window colors. Add the slim spire with a red light at about x=720, plus depth fog that turns the distant towers purple-grey.

differences.what: Right side is missing its key elements. There is no large cyan neon 'GAR…' sign, no dark glass building facade, no tall utility pole in the right foreground, and no warm, yellow-lit glass storefront at the lower right. The capture shows a dark void with a few small blocky colored boxes.
differences.fix: Add a multi-storey building with a large cyan neon letter sign (bloom, glowing tubes) at about y 160–240. Put a big warm amber-lit glass shopfront at the lower right (x 1510–1672, y 480–690). Add a tall, dark, wet utility pole from top to bottom at about x 1530–1650 with yellow/black bollards at its base. Remove the floating colored cubes.

differences.what: Storefronts under the bridge are dim, small and wrong. The reference shows a brightly lit convenience store with an 'ほしマート' sign and a green/orange/white stripe fascia, stocked shelves and bright interior light spilling onto the street. The capture has small dim windows and a pale pink-white blank wall block.
differences.where: Center, under the bridge, x 430–820, y 470–670
differences.fix: Model the ほしマート storefront with a white fascia, the ほしマート logo text and green/orange stripes. Add a bright 5000 K interior with shelves visible through the glass, and spill light onto the wet street. Replace the pink-white wall with the lit shop interiors and glass doors seen in the reference.

differences.what: The bridge underside, shutter building and props differ. The capture bridge is a clean slab with two thin white strip lights, while the reference shows exposed steel girders and a single warm fluorescent. The vending machine glows white-hot, where the reference machine is red-bodied with modest light. The shutter building is green-striped instead of rusty corrugated metal. Crushed cans on the road and sidewalk are missing, and wires and bunting are sparse.
differences.where: Bridge underside center; vending machine and shutter building center-right (x 1000–1300); cans at bottom center-right (x 1030, y 855 and x 1230, y 915)
differences.fix: Add I-beam girders and a single warm tube light under the bridge. Make the vending machine red, with emissive lowered so the product display is readable. Re-texture the shutter building in rusted corrugated steel with plywood-boarded windows and a rust-stained signboard. Place 2–3 crushed cans on the road and sidewalk. Add many more sagging overhead power and telecom cables crossing the top half of the frame from the right poles.
